title: growth-brain tick still runs growth:sync_cadence in the foreground under a fixed timeout (Hermes cron config, outside the repo)
evidence: Remaining half of growth-tick-kills-its-own-render (closed 2026-09-19): the repo side is fixed -- ReconcileStaleRuns bounds abandoned sync runs and Growth::RenderSalvage now recovers the renders themselves -- but the producer is still SIGKILLed by the tick's foreground budget (a ~45 min 5-render shortfall inside a 180s tool budget). tc-growth-harness-brain lives in ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/jobs.json, which is outside this repo, so it is filed rather than edited. Cheapest fix: run growth:sync_cadence detached (direct >> log 2>&1 &) and let the next tick's render_need top up what is missing -- sync_cadence counts existing posts, so a partial run is safe to resume; or split into per-slot batches; or raise the tick's tool timeout above the measured ~45 min worst case. Needs Tim's ok (cron config + spend behaviour).

2026-09-20 12:5xZ ops-triage: still open, but the option set is now narrowed by evidence -- the naive fix in this record (run growth:sync_cadence detached with >> log 2>&1 &) would COLLIDE with the tick's own GPU policy: the same prompt ends by stopping the heartbeat, SIGTERMing ComfyUI, verifying the port is closed and RELEASING the claim, so a detached producer would keep rendering into a GPU the tick has just handed back (and the next claimant would OOM against it). Three real options: (a) detach the producer AND defer the release to a follow-up tick/heartbeat that waits for it; (b) keep it foreground and give the rake task a self-imposed deadline so it exits cleanly between renders before the tool timeout (in-repo, no spend change -- the next tick's render_need tops up what it skipped); (c) split into per-slot batches. Repo-side debris handling is verified clean live this run (0 stuck PipelineRuns, 0 stuck ComfyuiJobs), so the residual is a truncated tick, not lost work. Needs Tim: launch mode + spend behaviour is his call.
